payloads.name: LegacyJB
payloads.description: PS5 jailbreak payload. Spectrum Library's Homebrew feature requires LegacyJB or etaHEN with Jailbreak Legacy enabled.

payloads.name: Spectrum Library
payloads.description: Native PS5 content library. Its Homebrew feature requires LegacyJB or etaHEN with Jailbreak Legacy enabled.

payloads.name: Pegasus DL
payloads.description: PS5 download manager. Requires a jailbroken, payload-capable PS5 and an ELF loader. Open its web UI from the same local network at http://<PS5-IP>:6970/. No separate FTP server or helper payload is required.
